name: Aave
description: Aave Pro is the official interface for Aave V4, live on Ethereum since 30 March 2026. V4 replaces separate per-chain markets with a hub-and-spoke design: liquidity hubs such as Core, Prime and Plus feed spokes like e-Mode markets, and since September 2026 an Equities Hub on Base accepts Coinbase tokenized stocks as collateral for USDC loans. Aave V3 keeps running at app.aave.com.
description_zh: Aave Pro 是 Aave V4 的官方界面，自 2026 年 3 月 30 日起在以太坊上线。V4 采用“枢纽—辐条”架构：Core、Prime、Plus 等流动性枢纽为 e-Mode 等市场提供资金；自 2026 年 9 月起，Base 上的股票枢纽接受 Coinbase 代币化股票作为借入 USDC 的抵押品。Aave V3 仍在 app.aave.com 运行。
repo_status: closed (protocol code aave/aave-v4 and aave-v4-sdk are public, the Pro frontend is not)

geo_site.method: ToS: region-based blocking or other technical methods; no site-level check in the app bundle

geo_feature.scope: Per-asset geo check (POST /api/geo -> areAssetsGeoblocked): a flagged asset can be viewed but not supplied or borrowed from a restricted region, closing positions stays allowed. The Equities Hub (Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base) is offered only outside the US.

screening.provider: ComplianceProvider -> own API route backed by COMPLIANCE_API_URL + COMPLIANCE_SECRET (provider not disclosed)
screening.fail_note: status=error shows the same blocked screen with a retry button

asset_filter: Equities Hub assets are geo-gated per region (Coinbase tokenized stocks, not offered in the US)

tos.us_scope: Equities Hub (tokenized stocks) is not offered in the US
tos.restricted: 18: BY, CI, Crimea, CU, DPR, IR, IQ, Kherson, LR, LY, LPR, MM, KP, RU, SD, SY, VE, Zaporizhzhia

notes: Closed frontend. Compliance and geo checks are server routes of pro.aave.com; the V4 contracts and the public SDK do not include them.
live: POST pro.aave.com/api/geo from RO (2026-10-10): USDC and WETH on Ethereum -> isGeoblocked=false

api_probes.name: asset geoblock
api_probes.note: The app asks which assets are geoblocked for the visitor (11 Ethereum assets: USDC, WETH, GHO, PYUSD, RLUSD, USDtb, sUSDe, USDe, USTB, USCC, EURC).
